name: Immoral Study Scenario 2: Iijima Yuka
original_name: インモラルスタディ シナリオ2 飯嶋由佳
source:
The main character is Professor Hitosuji, an excellent and well-known tutor. He can turn failing students into straight A students. His target this time is Yuka Ijima, the only daughter of the factory CEO. Until recently, she's been getting pretty good grades, but now she's been slipping quite a bit. Yuka has attitude problems...I have to find out why she's getting bad grades. I will take her killer body at the same time.


[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20081019184636/http://www.himeyashop.com/product_info.php/cPath/30_51/products_id/2162]Himeya Shop[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一条教授——一位优秀且知名的家教。他能将挂科的学生变成全A学生。他这次的目标是饭岛由佳，工厂老板的独生女。直到不久前，她的成绩还不错，但现在下滑了不少。由佳有态度问题……我必须找出她成绩下降的原因。当然，同时也要得到她那火辣的身材。

[来自[url=http://web.archive.org/web/20081019184636/http://www.himeyashop.com/product_info.php/cPath/30_51/products_id/2162]Himeya Shop[/url]]
